docs.title: Syntax
docs.text: SOCKET domain, type, protocol

docs.title: Description
docs.text: Open a socket (protocol is not handled yet) (see kernel routine for more information: https://orix-software.github.io/developer_manual/kernel/primitives/xsocket/)

docs.title: Input
docs.text: param Description domain The communication domain (e.g., AF_INET) (adress ex $abcd) type The type of socket (e.g., SOCK_STREAM) (address ex $abcd) protocol The protocol to be used (e.g., IPPROTO_TCP) (address ex $abcd)

docs.title: Returns
docs.text:
• Accumulator : The socket file descriptor (sockfd) or -1 on error

Example

 .include "sys/socket.inc" to get 'INVALID_SOCKET' definition
 SOCKET domain, type, protocol
 ; A contains the socket file descriptor (sockfd) or -1 on error
 cmp #INVALID_SOCKET
 beq @error
 ; No error
 sta socket_fd
 rts
 @error:
 ; Error
 rts
domain:
 .byt #AF_INET
type:
 .byt #SOCK_STREAM
protocol:
 .byt $00 ; Not handled yet
socket_fd:
 .byt $00

docs.title: Syntax
docs.text: CONNECT socket, ip, dest_port

docs.title: Description
docs.text: Connect a socket to a remote address (see kernel routine for more information: https://orix-software.github.io/developer_manual/kernel/primitives/xconnect/)

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
param Description socket The socket file descriptor ip The IP address to connect to (address ex $abcd) 32 bits big endian dest_port The destination port to connect to (address ex $abcd)

Example

 .include "sys/socket.inc" to get 'INVALID_SOCKET' definition
 CONNECT socket_fd, ip, dest_port
 rts
ip:
 .word $C0A80001 ; 192.168.0.1
dest_port:
 .word $0050 ; 80
socket_fd:
 .byt $00

docs.title: Syntax
docs.text: SEND socket, buffer, length

docs.title: Description
docs.text: Send data through a socket (see kernel routine for more information: https://orix-software.github.io/developer_manual/kernel/primitives/xsend/)

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
param Description socket The socket file descriptor buffer The buffer containing the data to send (address ex $abcd) length The length of the data to send (address ex $abcd)

Example

 .include "sys/socket.inc" to get 'INVALID_SOCKET' definition
 SEND socket_fd, buffer, length
 rts
buffer:
 .dsb 1000 ; Buffer address
length:
 .word 1000 ; Buffer length
socket_fd:
 .byt $00

docs.title: Syntax
docs.text: RECV socket, buffer, length

docs.title: Description
docs.text: Receive data from a socket, uses TR0 (see kernel routine for more information: https://orix-software.github.io/developer_manual/kernel/primitives/xrecv/)

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
param Description socket The socket file descriptor buffer The buffer to store the received data (address ex $abcd) length The length of the buffer (address ex $abcd)

Example

 RECV mysocket, mybuffer, length
 rts
mysocket:
 .byt $00
buffer:
 .dsb 1000
length:
 .word 1000

docs.title: Syntax
docs.text: CLOSE_SOCKET socket

docs.title: Description
docs.text: Close a socket (see kernel routine for more information: https://orix-software.github.io/developer_manual/kernel/primitives/xsocketclose/)

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
param Description socket The socket file descriptor

Example
